title: Verificación: Mac Gemma 4 12B ~10GB RSS leaves little headroom on 16GB systems with other apps
summary: Claim revisado: Gemma 4 12B Q4_K_M on Mac (llama.cpp Metal) uses only ~10GB RSS at 32K context - very efficient. Evidencia: Reply in the Mac setup thread: '不够用，16GB还得开几个docker，哪有那么多剩余内存给llm' (not enough; 16GB Mac still needs to run Docker etc.).. Caveat editorial: 10GB RSS for the model + server leaves minimal margin on base 16GB Macs when running browsers, IDEs, or containers simultaneously.. Reproducibilidad: high - directly references the exact 10GB / 16GB+ Mac claim and full command in the thread.
